en.headline: Police arrest father after 14-year-old boy injured in Sheung Wan
en.dek: A 35-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of ill-treatment of a child after the boy suffered injuries to his eyes, hands and forehead at a flat on Hospital Road.
body: Police arrested a 35-year-old man early this morning after receiving a report that he had improperly treated his 14-year-old son at a flat on Hospital Road in Sheung Wan.

Officers arrived after a woman, identified as the boy’s mother, reported the incident shortly before 1am. Preliminary inquiries suggested the man had used his hands to assault the boy. He was arrested on suspicion of ill-treatment or neglect of a child or young person under his care and is being held for investigation.

The boy sustained injuries to his eyes, hands and forehead. He remained conscious and was taken to Queen Mary Hospital for treatment. Police said the case appears to involve a discipline dispute. The Central District Crime Unit is following up.
No further details on the circumstances were released. Police reminded the public that anyone with information should contact them.

zh.headline: 西營盤14歲男童疑遭父親管教受傷 35歲父涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 警方凌晨接報後到醫院道18號調查，男童眼、手及額頭受傷清醒送院，父親涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略被捕。
body: 警方今早凌晨接獲報案，指一名14歲男童在西營盤醫院道18號單位曾遭35歲父親不恰當對待，經調查後拘捕該名男子。
據悉，男童母親報案後，警員到場初步調查，懷疑男子曾用手襲擊兒子，遂以涉嫌「對所看管兒童或少年人虐待或忽略」罪將他拘捕，現正扣留調查。案件交由中區警區刑事調查隊跟進。
男童眼部、手部及額頭受傷，送院時保持清醒，由救護車送往瑪麗醫院治理。據了解事件涉及管教問題。
警方暫未公布更多詳情。任何人士如有資料，歡迎聯絡警方。
